methodology.precision: TP/(TP+FP); uncertain excluded and counted separately
methodology.scope: tracked HEAD; .agents, minified, dependencies, generated route trees and build output excluded
methodology.partialCoverage: Exact parser-rejected files excluded in one bounded recovery; errors remain visible
methodology.coverage: A complete inventory of 60 rules is not a recall guarantee. Empty configurable bindings are unmeasured.
methodology.engineFindingIdentity: An acceptance requires exact standard revision, detector version, binding digest, fingerprint and sufficient authority. Human can satisfy agent authority; proposals never open a gate. Lineage is context. The review app separates unresolved Queue and auditable Decisions.
methodology.historicalErrors: 104 = 52 state rules affected by one unavailable KeepCart and one timed-out Panache scan; not 104 independently identified plugin defects.

caveats: Conditional projection, not a consumer config change or approval.
Retired triggers must be consolidated into their target reviews by the owner; replacement lint findings are not counted here.
Changed standard/detector versions reopen surviving acceptances; the replay counts all new matches, including previously accepted sites.
Artifact sources are the available replay population, not a fresh complete scan; new triggers outside those sources are unmeasured.
CI artifact engine 0.9.1 and replay engine 0.3.0 differ; parser failures retain old obligations conservatively.

rows.purpose: Flags switched-off refetch triggers, retries, or cache time (`refetchOn*: false`, `retry: false|0`, `gcTime: 0`) and server-rendered QueryClients without a `staleTime`, which need a stated freshness intent.

rows.diagnosis: Calibrate repository scope and inspect semantic exceptions; a trigger is not a proved defect.

rows.purpose: Flags @xstate/effect actors bound by createEffectActor(...) whose outcome the file never reads with join, waitFor, snapshots or subscribe.

rows.diagnosis: Calibrate repository scope and inspect semantic exceptions; a trigger is not a proved defect.
